Card Q&A.q: If I have 5 cards in hand when activating this card’s [When Digivolving] effect, how much memory do I gain?
If an opponent's Digimon gains an [On Deletion] effect from an effect or as an inherited effect from one of its digivolution cards, can this card's [When Attacking] effect target that Digimon?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Gain 1 memory for every 4 cards in your hand.

[When Attacking] If you have 8 or more cards in your hand and a Tamer in play, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect to the bottom of its owner's deck. Trash all of the digivolution cards of that Digimon.
